evidence.decision: Classifies static, editable, long-form and portable text; chooses actual scalable text, meaningful hierarchy and selective copying.
evidence.artifact: Requires edited strings with semantic style and control-association contract or concrete ambiguity/legibility findings.
evidence.transformation: Shipping tracking ID changes from faint rasterized uncopyable information to a clear Tracking Number caption and selectable scalable value.
evidence.verification: Checks long localization, enlarged/bold text, appearances, copying and correct accessible association; rejects rasterized essentials and clipped meaning.
evidence.applicability: Dynamic Type is scoped to support; Watch temporal components are distinguished from generic frameworks without promised automatic updates.
evidence.handoffs: Routes long selectable material to Text views and editable values to Text fields.
evidence.distinctiveness: Information portability, semantic label roles and association produce decisions specific to short uneditable text.
